mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ed.exchange_batch_id, SUM(CASE WHEN ed.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_quantity, MIN(gb.display_name) AS display_name FROM exchange_detail ed LEFT JOIN service_code sc ON sc.id = ed.service_code_id LEFT JOIN service_code_generate_batch gb ON gb.id = sc.generate_batch_id GROUP BY ed.exchange_batch_id ) detail_summary ON detail_summary.exchange_batch_id = b.id

b.id AS batch_id, b.exchange_batch_no AS batch_no, b.request_id, b.owner_company_id, dc.company_name AS owner_company_name, b.spec_code, detail_summary.display_name, b.service_type, b.duration_days, b.quantity, COALESCE(detail_summary.success_quantity, 0) AS success_quantity, b.status, b.account_prefix, b.generation_source, b.created_at, b.completed_at, b.last_error_code, b.last_error_message

sql.if: AND ( b.request_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.exchange_batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.spec_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.generation_source LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR detail_summary.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.operator_user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM exchange_batch b LEFT JOIN dealer_company dc ON dc.company_id = b.owner_company_id
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC
